prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Hairen, the untameable sea humanoid. This is a COMPLETE REDRAW with new, clean, anatomically separated composition.
ANATOMY: ONE humanlike head, TWO eyes, TWO arms, TWO legs [hairen-c01]. BOTH hands clearly display FIVE WEBBED digits: one separate thumb and four fingers, thin living skin membrane BETWEEN all digits. BOTH feet clearly display FIVE webbed toes including large inner toe. Hands never touch or overlap feet. Broad loose living grey-olive SKIN folds hang like hakama trousers over hips/thighs [hairen-c02,c03]. Fully opaque plain charcoal undergarment covers torso and pelvis under skin flaps. Not woven trousers, no seams or hems on skin. Feral humanlike face with bared ordinary teeth, wet tangled hair, narrowed defiant eyes; no fins, gills, horns or pointed ears.
MOMENT: Surge upright out of the sea onto a broad flat rock toward viewer, back bent aggressively forward, shoulders hunched. Both arms held outward at SHOULDER HEIGHT, palms toward viewer, all five webbed digits spread widely and separated in silhouette. Both legs apart below hips. Both feet planted on two separated foreground rocks with toes facing viewer, visibly attached through ankles to separate legs. Hands in upper half, feet in lower corners: four extremities never overlap. Make every digit countable; leave uncluttered dark background behind each hand and foot.
POWER: No magic. Fierce untameable character [hairen-c05] expressed as defiant bodily confrontation. Ordinary surf splashes against rocks.
SCALE & CAMERA: Slight low angle, full tightly framed figure, face upper central, hands beside face, feet bottom, no giant scale.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one hard cold moon side-light against deep walnut black night, strong edge light on web membranes, ordinary sea spray.
SURFACE: Wet slick living skin, heavy glossy skin folds, coarse opaque charcoal undergarment, salt-wet rock.
SETTING: Sea coast rocks at night, dark sea behind [hairen-c01,c02].
MOOD: dangerous uncanny sea being confronting viewer, never ordinary relaxed man.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, pseudoletters, logo, border, watermark, gore or nudity; no extra heads, limbs or digits; no copyrighted film/game/anime/comic design; no generic glowing aura, neon outlines, energy ribbons or floating runes.
depicted_variant: Untameable webbed sea humanoid with hanging hakama-like living skin

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native1254 and200px inspected. Two separated palms each have thumb plus four fingers, five webbed digits. Two independently attached feet each show five toes with webbing; hands are shoulder-level and never overlap feet. Living grey skin folds over hips read as organic rather than cloth; opaque charcoal torso/pelvis layer. One head/two eyes/two arms/two legs. Untameable confrontation, close framing and huge webbed hands remain uncanny at200. No extra appendages, gills, fins, aura, text or gore. Seven Sangar checks pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and native crops of both hands, both feet (4x zoom), face and hip folds. The r02 defects are fixed for the hands: the left-frame hand (creature's right) shows a thumb plus four fingers, as does the right-frame hand (creature's left), both with membrane between the fingers; the feet are now separate, attached to two legs, and do not overlap the hands. One head, two eyes, two arms, two legs. The grey-olive hanging skin folds over the hips and thighs (hairen-c03) sit over an opaque charcoal undergarment, the night sea rocks match c01, and the lunging confrontation (c05) reads at 200px. But the foreground foot at lower left (the creature's right foot) has only FOUR webbed toes: a big toe plus three, four nails and three webs. The lower-right foot has five. This contradicts the receipt visual_requirement 'two separate five-toed webbed feet', the prompt, the Codex visual_review and root native review (both claim five toes on both feet), and the explicit r02 correction 'two separate webbed feet with five toes each'. The feet are deliberately framed as countable foreground features of the documented webbed hands and feet (c02), so the mismatched four-toed foot fails Uji Sangar #5.
